title: Jared Verse to wear No. 8 with Browns, Dillon Gabriel will change his number

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jared Verse to wear No. 8 with Browns, Dillon Gabriel will change his number
sources.description: Jared Verse and Dillon Gabriel were both wearing No. 8 at Browns practice this week, but that won't be the case for long.
